#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, b;
    cin >> n >> b;
    vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
    }

    vector<int> costs(n);
    int size = 0;
    int balance = (a[0] % 2 == 0 ? 1 : -1);

    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        if (balance == 0) {
            costs[size++] = abs(a[i] - a[i - 1]);
        }
        if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
            ++balance;
        } else {
            --balance;
        }
    }

    sort(costs.begin(), costs.begin() + size);
    long long total = 0;
    int ans = 0;

    for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
        if (total + costs[i] <= b) {
            total += costs[i];
            ++ans;
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
